resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1932 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts describes a fire tower being built at Millinocket Lake. The 1934 state line and the Historical Society place a wooden tower on Millinocket Hill in 1934. The sources do not say the two are the same, so the record uses only the 1934 hill tower.
The Historical Society gives 1955 as the removal year. It also mentions a 1954 lot clearing for the hospital, when the blurry photo was found; that is a different event. The record uses 1955.

notes_for_editor: Brief had no events; built 1934 and removed 1955 are now recorded. The Historical Society post is the main source for design and removal, and the 1934 build rests on two sources (the state line as quoted by Forest Lookouts, and the Society). Access left unset because no source describes it. No staffing or fire history found. Not checked: original 1932 Presque Isle Star-Herald item and Maine Forest Service records. The Millinocket Regional Hospital history page was read for context (current hospital location opened 1955) but is not cited because it does not mention the tower.
